$description: ProgressSteps (platform/components/ProgressSteps, library wave 7, lane A): its component tokens. The current step takes the action color, a done step the selected state, a failed one the soft danger colors, an upcoming one the strong border; the compact bar is ProgressBar's track and fills. Every color an existing role.

progress-steps-gap.$description: ProgressSteps: the space between the lines of wrapped horizontal steps.

progress-steps-head-gap.$description: ProgressSteps step: the space between the marker and the name.

progress-steps-marker-size.$description: ProgressSteps marker: its width and height.

progress-steps-marker-radius.$description: ProgressSteps marker: its corners (the control radius).

progress-steps-marker-font-size.$description: ProgressSteps marker: the step number's size.

progress-steps-marker-font-weight.$description: ProgressSteps marker: the step number's weight.

progress-steps-marker-icon-size.$description: ProgressSteps marker: the check or alert icon's size.

progress-steps-marker-background.$description: ProgressSteps upcoming step: the marker's fill.

progress-steps-marker-border-color.$description: ProgressSteps upcoming step: the marker's edge.

progress-steps-current-marker-background.$description: ProgressSteps current step: the marker on the action color.

progress-steps-current-marker-border-col.$description: ProgressSteps current step: the marker's edge.

progress-steps-current-marker-text.$description: ProgressSteps current step: the number on the action color.

progress-steps-complete-marker-backgroun.$description: ProgressSteps done step: the marker in the selected fill.

progress-steps-complete-marker-border-co.$description: ProgressSteps done step: the marker's selected edge.

progress-steps-error-marker-background.$description: ProgressSteps step that needs attention: the marker's soft danger fill.

progress-steps-error-marker-border-color.$description: ProgressSteps step that needs attention: the marker's edge.

progress-steps-error-marker-text.$description: ProgressSteps step that needs attention: the alert icon.

progress-steps-label-text.$description: ProgressSteps: a done or current step's name.

progress-steps-current-label-font-weight.$description: ProgressSteps current step: its name's weight.

progress-steps-error-label-text.$description: ProgressSteps step that needs attention: its name.

progress-steps-description-indent.$description: ProgressSteps: the second line starts under the name (past the marker and its gap).

progress-steps-connector-color.$description: ProgressSteps connector: the line after an upcoming or current step.

progress-steps-complete-connector-color.$description: ProgressSteps connector: the line after a done step.

progress-steps-connector-min-length.$description: ProgressSteps connector: its least length (horizontal: it grows to fill the row).

progress-steps-connector-margin.$description: ProgressSteps connector: the space between the line and the steps on either side.

progress-steps-vertical-connector-indent.$description: ProgressSteps vertical: the connector runs down the middle of the marker column.

progress-steps-vertical-connector-min-le.$description: ProgressSteps vertical: the connector's least height between two steps.

progress-steps-vertical-gap.$description: ProgressSteps vertical: the space above and below each connector and under each name.

progress-steps-button-radius.$description: ProgressSteps clickable step: the corners of its hover fill and focus outline.

progress-steps-button-padding.$description: ProgressSteps clickable step: the space around the marker and name, inside the hover fill.

progress-steps-button-hover-background.$description: ProgressSteps clickable step with the pointer over it: the hover fill.

progress-steps-button-focus-outline-colo.$description: ProgressSteps clickable step with keyboard focus: the outline.

progress-steps-button-focus-outline-widt.$description: ProgressSteps clickable step with keyboard focus: the outline's width.

progress-steps-compact-gap.$description: ProgressSteps compact: the space between the text and the bar.

progress-steps-count-text.$description: ProgressSteps compact: the Step 2 of 5 text.

progress-steps-count-font-weight.$description: ProgressSteps compact: the Step 2 of 5 part's weight (the step's name after it is regular).

progress-steps-count-label-font-weight.$description: ProgressSteps compact: the step's name after the count.

progress-steps-segments-gap.$description: ProgressSteps compact: the space between two segments.

progress-steps-segment-height.$description: ProgressSteps compact: a segment's height (the small ProgressBar's track).

progress-steps-segment-background.$description: ProgressSteps compact: an upcoming step's segment (ProgressBar's track).

progress-steps-segment-done-background.$description: ProgressSteps compact: a done or current step's segment (ProgressBar's fill).

progress-steps-segment-error-background.$description: ProgressSteps compact: a failed step's segment (ProgressBar's danger fill).
